The [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] '''Light Frigate''' was a smaller [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was often used in [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs enforcement]]. It was frequently captured by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and used in [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]].<ref name="AJ2" />
